olivia (partnerships): Quick win — ArborCare signed a 12-month Dedicated commitment and approved our ISV marketplace listing. Pilot case-study kickoff is scheduled for tomorrow. :tada: Details below.

jess (success): Amazing news! Do we have approval to publish a customer quote and use their logo?

olivia (partnerships): Yes — Legal cleared a short exec quote (see NDA notes). CS to collect a quote during the kickoff. Contract highlights: 12-month committed throughput, optional private VPC, managed onboarding (target 4 weeks).

max (revops): Finance FYI — this nets to ~$420k ARR (after marketplace fees). RevOps will ingest the contract and set billing cadence to monthly. Sending the signed contract to ops now.

tara (solutions): Solutions plan: allocating a 2-node Dedicated pool (A100-equivalent) and we'll serve MPT-7B-r with int8 quant profile to hit cost targets. I pushed the kickoff agenda to the calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meeting/arborkickoff

jess (success): I'll run through the onboarding checklist tomorrow and schedule the executive quote capture. Can someone share the case-study NDA and logo guidelines?

olivia (partnerships): Shared: https://docs.redwood.ai/case-studies/arborcare-nda (internal link). ArborCare agreed to a short co-branded case study and a marketplace highlight in week 6 post-go-live.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: provision-dedicated-pool job queued for arborcare-dedicated-01 — ETA ~8h. (job id: job_20260315_441)

tara (solutions): Tagging @product-leads for a quick review of the feature-callout wording in the marketplace listing. Will we be OK to mention our auto-batching and KV caching benefits?

max (revops): :thumbsup: Great work. Shoutout to olivia & jess for driving momentum. Please ping me when the onboarding invoice goes live so I can reconcile against the committed usage.

jess (success): +1. I'll post a short post-mortem/case-study draft in #partnerships once we have the first week metrics.

olivia (partnerships): Thanks team — huge teamwork. Will update this thread with the kickoff notes and next steps after tomorrow's call.
